# Performance evidence

Validation only. Positive ΔCE means control CE minus B3 CE; positive ΔMRR/Hit/AUC means B3 minus control. Means ± sample SD. All paired per-seed values, t intervals and sign-flip p-values are in phase RESULT JSONs. Three screening seeds are exploratory. Repeated same canonical validation across earlier research induces selection bias; multiplicity is not corrected. Seed uncertainty does not quantify dataset/generalization uncertainty.
